comment: save.c saveobjchn() 783-795 and restore.c restobjchn() 283-290, for objects in the inventory. A debug Valkyrie wishes for a food ration, which joins her own, and a blessed spellbook of sleep, and creates a newt beside her. She starts eating a ration and the newt interrupts at once, so the partly eaten ration is split off as f and is svc.context.victual.piece; she starts studying the book and the newt interrupts again, leaving it svc.context.spbook.book. She saves: dosave0()'s saveobjchn() of the inventory nulls both pointers and keeps their o_ids, and restobjchn() points them back at the objects with those ids. The second segment restores, keeps no save file, eats f, which doeat() resumes ("You resume your meal.") because it is victual.piece, and reads the book, which study_book() continues ("You continue your efforts to memorize the spell.") because it is spbook.book. Seeds, datetimes, character and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
